label: Ordinary token launch
summary: Start a fixed-supply token and canonical v4 pool without inventing project-defined hook behavior or platform economics.
requiredFacts: Token name, symbol, fixed supply and immutable control model
Canonical PoolKey, launch price-discovery path and initial liquidity
Any fee or hook behavior explicitly requested by preserved intent or selected by the current central policy
Claim, exit, metadata and retirement behavior
requiredTests: Fixed supply and absence of hidden issuer controls
Canonical pool initialization and ordinary trading
Any explicitly selected hook behavior in every applicable swap quadrant
Claims, liquidity exit and metadata binding
risks: Adding custom price or transfer behavior invalidates the ordinary profile
External routing and indexing remain provider-specific evidence states
